name: Real Story
promise: A real story shown through real records, with one question answered by the end.
rules: Only facts with status verified go into the narration; 'likely' facts must be hedged on screen and in words.
Quotes only from a transcript, with time and source.
Every real record on screen carries a source line; every illustration is labelled as such.
Secondary retellings help to find facts; only primary material goes on screen. No other creators' videos.
Synthetic voice, music and generated images are disclosed in the description and in the upload flag.
Thumbnail: clickbait but honest; everything promised is in the video.

style.image_style_prompt: Editorial illustration for a documentary: deep navy blue palette (#0D2A52 to #081B38) with amber (#F2C14E) light accents and a single red (#C8261C) highlight, soft film grain, cinematic side light, simple bold shapes, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

voice.base_direction: Calm documentary narrator, close to the mic, plain American English, lets numbers land with a short pause.
